author: Thermetrics
versionDescription: Added the missing 'Documents' tab (admin upload/manage view for Employee + Company Documents, mirroring what's shown read-only in the 🌴 My Employment Info app) and an 'Upcoming Anniversaries' card on Overview — both reconstructed from screenshots of the live app since this repo's local copy had fallen behind. Also re-applied a known fix from the version gap: PTO Approve/Deny/Cancel now sets the required 'Approved By' field (was failing validation silently before).
